versions.changelog:
- Initial release of jf-open-pro-video-masking (version 1.0.0).
- Supports one-key video masking: camera pans to privacy position, stops live video and recording.
- Provides commands to enable, disable, query status, and toggle masking mode.
- Requires PTZ-enabled devices, proper environment variable setup, device binding, and online status.
- Includes command-line script for easy operation and detailed setup instructions.
